title: Sell a minimum share of ethanol-blended petrol
what: As a volume fuel retailer, ensure ethanol is at least the minimum percentage of all petrol sold in each period.

sources.title: Biofuels Act 2007 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A volume fuel retailer must ensure that the volume of ethanol sold by the retailer (in petrol-ethanol blend) during a relevant period is not less than the minimum ethanol percentage of the total volume of all petrol (including petrol-ethanol blend) sold by the retailer during the relevant period
